root.command: SELECT MinReminderDate, DateDiff("d", MinReminderDate, Now()) AS DaysSinceMinReminder FROM SysDataTbl WHERE ID = 1

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, c.enabled, c.PredictionDisabled, c.AlwaysSendChkUp, c.LastDateSentReminder, cu.NextCoffeeBy, DateDiff("d", Now(), cu.NextCoffeeBy) AS DaysUntilNextCoffee, nr.NextDeliveryDate, DateDiff("d", Now(), nr.NextDeliveryDate) AS DaysUntilDelivery, DateDiff("d", cu.NextCoffeeBy, nr.NextDeliveryDate) AS DeliveryVsCoffeeGap FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 10, Now()) ORDER BY c.CompanyName

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, c.enabled AS IsEnabled, c.PredictionDisabled AS IsPredictionDisabled, cu.NextCoffeeBy, nr.NextDeliveryDate, DateAdd("d", 9, cu.NextCoffeeBy) AS CoffeeByPlus9Days, IIF(nr.NextDeliveryDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, cu.NextCoffeeBy), 'YES', 'NO') AS DeliveryInWindow, IIF((c.LastDateSentReminder IS NULL) OR (c.LastDateSentReminder <> Now()), 'YES', 'NO') AS NotSentToday, IIF(cu.NextCoffeeBy > (SELECT MinReminderDate FROM SysDataTbl WHERE ID=1), 'YES', 'NO') AS AfterMinReminder, IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM OrdersTbl o WHERE o.CustomerID=c.CustomerID AND o.RoastDate >= Now() AND o.RoastDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now())), 'YES', 'NO') AS HasRecentOrder FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 10, Now()) ORDER BY c.CompanyName

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, c.EmailAddress, c.ReminderCount, cu.NextCoffeeBy, nr.NextDeliveryDate, nr.PreperationDate FROM ((CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID) WHERE ((c.LastDateSentReminder IS NULL) OR (c.LastDateSentReminder <> Now())) AND (c.enabled = True) AND (c.PredictionDisabled = False) AND (cu.NextCoffeeBy > (SELECT MinReminderDate FROM SysDataTbl WHERE ID=1)) AND ((nr.NextDeliveryDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, cu.NextCoffeeBy)) OR c.AlwaysSendChkUp = True) AND (NOT EXISTS( SELECT o.CustomerID FROM OrdersTbl AS o WHERE o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND o.RoastDate >= Now() AND o.RoastDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now()) )) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 10, Now()) ORDER BY c.CompanyName

SELECT ct.CityID, ct.CityName, nr.PreperationDate, nr.DeliveryDate, nr.NextPreperationDate, nr.NextDeliveryDate, DateDiff("d", nr.DeliveryDate, Now()) AS DaysSinceLastUpdate FROM CityTbl AS ct LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON ct.CityID = nr.CityID ORDER BY ct.CityName

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, c.City AS CityID, ct.CityName, nr.NextDeliveryDate, cu.NextCoffeeBy FROM ((CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN CityTbl AS ct ON c.City = ct.CityID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 10, Now()) AND (nr.NextDeliveryDate IS NULL OR nr.NextDeliveryDate < Now()) ORDER BY c.CompanyName

SELECT 'Updated NextCoffeeBy (7-10 days out)' AS CheckCategory, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM ClientUsageTbl WHERE NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 10, Now()) UNION ALL SELECT 'With NULL/Old NextDeliveryDate' AS CheckCategory, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 10, Now()) AND (nr.NextDeliveryDate IS NULL OR nr.NextDeliveryDate < Now()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Disabled or PredictionDisabled' AS CheckCategory, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 10, Now()) AND (c.enabled = False OR c.PredictionDisabled = True) UNION ALL SELECT 'With existing orders in next 9 days' AS CheckCategory, COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS CustomerCount FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) INNER JOIN OrdersTbl AS o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 10, Now()) AND o.RoastDate >= Now() AND o.RoastDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now())
